threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep walking into shops and expecting the staff to say 'hello' instead of staring at you like you're lost. It's a classic Dalston move.
Last night on the N37, a guy was having a full-on debate with the bus driver about the best late-night takeaway in Brixton. Spoiler: they both agreed on the chicken shop.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy serenading his pigeon flock with an accordion at Hermannplatz. Only in Neukölln could this feel so normal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find late-night bakeries selling fresh bread at 2 AM while the rest of the city sleeps, perfect for a midnight snack run.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid BART when there's a 'loud bang' at Civic Center—like, that’s a weekly occurrence.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a No. 14 packed to the brim with folks, yet somehow the guy in the back kept trying to sell tacos. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just Gaudí vibes and quirky shops, but miss out on the local bars where the real community breathes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell who's new by the way they hesitate at the tram stops, trying to decipher the routes while clutching their phones.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when someone mentions the 'halfie' doors—everyone here knows they’re not just a style choice.
Last night, a couple near me on the 196 bus were reenacting their worst dates. Everyone laughed, even the grumpy driver cracked a smile.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw a guy juggling flaming torches in front of the Spätkauf while the kebab shop was blasting 90s techno. Classic Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a waste container painted as a street musician. It’s a quirky reminder that art is everywhere here, even in the bins.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to avoid the Civic Center BART station after a loud bang—only tourists would be confused by the evacuation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the bus while a woman nervously checked her watch. Only in the Tenderloin do you get a performance and a panic in one ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the locals are sipping wine in the Plaça just for the vibe. Nah, we’re just trying to avoid the overpriced drinks and enjoy the shade.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still marveling at how many gelato flavors there are while holding a massive cone—everyone else just gets a standard one.
